compute.reported_as: Our best performing model had 4 layers and 16 hidden nodes. We used the Adam optimizer [33] with a learning rate of 3 x 10^-3 and the default parameters. Our optimization procedure was as follows. First, we optimized the phase structure for 500 steps by setting Re(log(psi)) = 0 before outputting psi. (...)
